about: Destiny Logistics & Infra Ltd is a Kolkata-based construction contractor and logistics aggregator. Logistics historically covers third-party road transport plus packing, loading/unloading and end-to-end delivery; the company also markets manpower and international container-shipping services. Statutory FY26 reporting, however, recognises only two operating segments—Construction and Transport. [1]
